units.source_text: 薰大将走近明石皇后御前，和她谈谈法华八讲的尊严、六条院主与紫夫人在世时之事，看看送大公主后剩下来的画幅，顺便说道：

en.t: General Kaoru went up before Empress Akashi, spoke with her about the dignity of the Lotus Sutra Eight Lectures and about the days when the lord of Rokujo-in and Lady Murasaki were alive, looked over the paintings left after some had been sent to the eldest princess, and then said in passing:

units.source_text: “我家那位二公主，为了辞别九重，降嫁臣下，心中常感委屈，很可怜呢。

en.t: The second princess at my house feels constantly wronged and pitiful because she had to leave the imperial palace and marry down to a subject.

units.source_text: 她认为大公主不同她通信，是由于自己已是臣下身份，故见弃于大公主。

en.t: She thinks the eldest princess no longer writes to her because she has become the wife of a subject, and that the eldest princess has therefore cast her aside.
Because of this, she has long been sunk in gloom.

units.source_text: 但望此种图画等物，以后便中也送她一些。

en.t: I only hope that, when there is a convenient chance later, you might send her a few things like these paintings as well.
It would be all right for me to carry them to her.

units.source_text: 不过我带去就不大稀罕了。”

en.t: Only, if I bring them, they will not seem quite so special.

units.source_text: 怎么会见弃于大公主呢？

en.t: How could she possibly have been abandoned by the eldest princess?

units.source_text: 她们两人在宫中时，相去很近，时时通信往还。

en.t: When the two of them were in the palace, they lived very near each other and often exchanged letters.

units.source_text: 后来分居两地，自然音问稀少了。

en.t: Later, after they came to live in separate places, their messages naturally became less frequent.

units.source_text: 我就劝大公主写信给她吧。

en.t: I shall urge the eldest princess to write to her.

units.source_text: 你叫二公主也不要有顾虑。”

en.t: You should also tell the second princess not to be hesitant.

units.source_text: 薰大将说：“二公主怎么可以冒昧写信呢？

en.t: General Kaoru said, How could the second princess presume to write so boldly?

units.source_text: 她虽然不是你亲生的，但我和你有姐弟之谊。

en.t: Although she is not your own child, you and I share the bond of elder sister and younger brother.

units.source_text: 倘蒙看在这面上加以青眼，实甚欣幸。

en.t: If you would kindly show her favor on account of that bond, I would be truly grateful.

units.source_text: 况且她们本来惯于通信往还，如今忽然见弃，乃痛心之事。”

en.t: Besides, the two of them were long accustomed to exchanging letters, so to be suddenly abandoned now is a painful thing.

units.source_text: 他说这种话，实出于好色之心，但明石皇后意想不到。

en.t: He said these things in truth out of amorous desire, but Empress Akashi never imagined it.
